sample_id.description: Unique identifier for this environmental sample in our lab.

temp.description: Temperature of the sample at the time of sampling in degree Celsius

salinity.description: Practical salinity of the water sample in PSU.

decimalLatitude.description: Latitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

site_longitude.description: Longitude of where the sample was taken, in decimal degrees.

collection_date.description: Calendar date when the environmental sample was collected.

water_temperature_C.description: In-situ water temperature measured at the sampling moment, Celsius.

habitat.description: Local-scale environment or habitat where the sample was collected.

sample_material.description: What the sample physically is (water, soil, sediment, etc.).

broad_biome.description: Broad environmental context of the sampling site (biome-level).

location_name.value: USA: Atlantic Ocean, east of Florida
location_name.description: Human-readable place name for the sampling location.

collected_by.description: Name of the person who collected the sample.

collection_gear.description: Device or tool used to collect the environmental sample.

volume_collected_L.description: Volume of water collected from the environment, in liters.

filter_pore_um.description: Pore size of the filter used during sample filtration, micrometers.

sample_depth_m.description: Depth below the surface where the sample was taken, in meters.

storage_freezer_C.description: Temperature of the freezer where the sample was stored before extraction.

ph.description: pH of the water sample at collection.

project_code.description: Short code for the research project this sample belongs to.

notes_field.value: Slight chop; bottle rinsed twice before fill.
notes_field.description: Free-text notes written by the field team during sampling.

lab_internal_batch.description: Our lab's internal batch label for DNA extraction runs. Not part of any public standard.
